quote: We propose Merger-as-a-Stealer, a two-stage framework for extracting targeted PII embedded from other aligned models by uploading malicious model parameters... The attacker extracts targeted PII through direct queries against the merged model.
Large language models (LLMs) have gained significant attention in modern machine learning and offer efficient solutions across various fields
outputs: The paper evaluates generated outputs in the form of PII (e.g., email addresses, phone numbers) extracted from LLMs after model merging.

quote: We evaluate the performance of our attacks using three metrics... Exact Match (Exact)... Longest Common Subsequence Rate (LCSR)... Memorization Score (Mem) uses ROUGE-L.

We evaluate the performance of our attacks using three metrics... Exact Match (Exact) measures whether the extracted PII exactly matches the reference data... Longest Common Subsequence Rate (LCSR)... Memorization Score (Mem) uses ROUGE-L to assess the overall overlap between training data and the output under attack.
We evaluate the performance of our attacks using three metrics. It should be noted that these metrics range from 0 to 1, and they are represented as percentages throughout this paper.
